snippet.title: Legend of Heroes 4 A Tear of Vermillion Remake played on PSP #01
snippet.description:
I am going to play a game called 'Legend of Heroes 4, A Tear of Vermillion'.
This is the 4th Game of the Legend of Heroes Series which was released in 1996 and later on and later on was released as a Remake Version on PSP with English Subtitles. This is the Second Game that deals with Gagharv Trilogy. 
Thank you very much for watching. 
Please Subscribe, Give me Thumbs Up & Leave Comments.

'Legend of Heroes 4, A Tear of Vermillion Remake - PSP Gameplay' Full Playlist at 
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLAcNZypwj-uoq6tYZiF05tmqCWOjPBxZ3

Also, Check the Japanese Version of the Full Playlist at
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLAcNZypwj-uo_3H3jPRdCwutxN0c6Dmrm
